newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bomb hurts six in Pakistan city during Jiang visit.
newsitem.headline: Bomb hurts six in Pakistan city during Jiang visit.

text.p: A car bomb injured at least six people in the Pakistani city of Lahore on Tuesday while Chinese President Jiang Zemin was there, police said.
There was no immediate information about the motive or who set off the bomb.
Police said it was planted in a van parked outside the busy Panorama shopping centre in Lahore, capital of the central province of Punjab.
Jiang Zemin visited Lahore as part of a four-day state visit to Pakistan during a tour of South Asia.
Gunmen have killed at least two activists of the minority Shi'ite Moslem sect in the past three days in attacks for which the sect blamed a rival militant group from the majority Sunni sect.

Pakistani officials have also often accused intelligence agencies of neighbouring India of acts of sabotage to avenge Pakistan's support for Moslem militants fighting Indian rule over two-thirds of the disputed Himalayan region of Kashmir. India has denied such charges.
